The data validation worker acts as a temporal filter, ensuring that only validated picks contribute to performance statistics. The admin session stub provides a deterministic fallback for UI testing, isolating frontend logic from backend dependencies. These primitives form a layered abstraction where each layer serves a distinct epistemic role: static rendering, temporal validation, and synthetic authentication. Failure modes include stale snapshots, invalid pick accumulation, and session misalignment. Dualities emerge in how stubbed vs. real data affect inference reliability and state transitions.
